references.title: Ampup implementation, frozen procedural library, methodology and full trajectories

methodology.notes: Ampup Memory System with OpenRouter qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902, reasoning_effort=high; native create_llm_agent with a document-derived procedural library, workflow navigation, and scope-restricted BM25/grep top-10 search. Scope begins empty; a returned nonempty SKILL.md selects a workflow and source links on subsequently returned REFERENCES.md pages enter scope. Union across opened pages/workflows; BM25 statistics are recomputed over scope. No global-search fallback. Direct source reads remain unrestricted. Additional read_knowledge_file tool and appended system-policy instructions make this a custom submission. The frozen library was tuned using development-task analysis and pooled golden-document labels from the evaluated task set. This is development-set evidence, not a held-out or document-only learning result. No per-task gold labels are exposed to the agent at runtime. All 97 base banking tasks have four scored conversations, seeds 626729/373753/361454/1567. Public native inputs match Sierra commit 5bfa7e37b36656b37dc6d022156be6563c1007f3. GPT-5.2 user simulator uses low reasoning via OpenRouter. Native deterministic scoring and the native NL rubric were retained, but the NL judge used the OpenRouter GPT-4.1 alias rather than a dated pinned snapshot. A known task_102 rubric/conversation age discrepancy is retained. The submitted metrics use native saved rewards; relaxed replay results are not submitted scores. Recognized unscored operational failures were retried up to five attempts; no scored case was retried. Nine task/trial pairs had prior failed attempts. Counting those first attempts as failures gives pass1=55.927835%, pass2=44.158076%, pass3=37.371134%, pass4=32.989691%. Primary results use the completed scored attempts under this disclosed custom retry protocol. Two ENOSPC failures lacked error.json; their errors were reconstructed separately from preserved logs, not inserted into original attempts. Concurrency changed from 3 to 5 to 6 across runs. Cost is mean saved agent inference cost only, as computed by the official submission helper: $0.460561742. The analysis including simulator and judge is $0.485038660 per scored conversation; including recorded failed-attempt overhead is at least $0.490250859. Memory construction, local compute and maintenance are excluded; incomplete interrupted logs make retry-inclusive cost a lower bound. Export combines preserved individual simulations into one Results file without changing messages, tool calls/results, rewards, costs or seeds. Aggregate Info is reconstructed from saved configs: task-specific request/session attribution headers are omitted there; original model responses remain in each simulation. Custom environment domain name is mapped to banking_knowledge solely for leaderboard indexing; exact custom policy and tool definitions are retained. Please review development-data exposure and retry/judge conventions before accepting this on the Custom track.

verification.details: 97 base tasks x 4 trials. Current public format/task/trial validation and official metric recomputation passed locally. Custom policy, file-reader tool, development-label tuning, judge alias and retry convention are disclosed. Original scored simulations are unchanged.
